requirements.description: User wants the senior day center to be located near healthcare services. Per the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), the threshold is set to 75.

User prefers energy class D or better, so the energy class must be one of A1-A4, B, C or D. Area (at least 360 sqm), capacity (18 people), and proximity to healthcare are not energy requirements and are excluded.

The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area. The 18-person capacity is not converted into an area threshold because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Energy class and proximity to healthcare are outside the reference columns and are handled by other agents. Turin is a city, so it is not mapped to comune_code.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 360 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND healthcare >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type exact match) with surface_area >= 360, energy_class from A1 to D, healthcare score >= 75, and within 3.0 km of the given coordinates. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the center point. Capacity for 18 people and the Turin place name were not in the extracted requirements, so no predicates were added for them.
